notes:
Scheme B (foreplane + wing + T-tail) refinement sweep, AVL only. ESTIMATES.
Grid: foreplane area x foreplane LE x-station; HT as in B (ht_scale_B = 0.6 -> 7.2 m2).  Aspect ratio, taper, z, sweep,
airfoil as params. CG placed for 15% static margin per combo. Cruise trim CL 0.631 (80 m/s, rho 0.9093).
Foreplane incidence starts at params incidence_B (+2 deg); if the wing would stall first (trimmed CL sweep,
critical-section, clmax wing 1.6 / foreplane 1.4) incidence is raised (interpolated, then verified) up to INC_MAX.
Optional: HT-size variants at the recommended point (separate table). Range as range.m defaults.
